text:
Marie (People Ops): Heads up — external guest arriving 3:00pm today (Jordan from Nimbus). One large envelope addressed to Jordan came in this morning and is at the desk. Can someone confirm badge + seating?
Front Desk (Bot): Package logged: 1x large envelope for Jordan. Badge printed and waiting. QR check-in sent to guest email.
AJ: Prefer to give them a small meeting space — Conf B is free at 3, or we can use the 4th-floor hotdesk if it's quick.
Devon: Conf B would be better, quieter for conversation.
Pete: I can meet Jordan at the lobby and escort up. Is someone able to put their name on the whiteboard?
Marie (People Ops): Perfect — @AJ can you reserve Conf B 2:45–4:15 and put "Jordan (Nimbus)" on the board? Also please move envelope to the room.
AJ: On it — reserving now. Will also move the envelope.
Front Desk (Bot): Reservation created: Conf B 2:45–4:15. Envelope transferred to holding locker #3; Pete assigned pickup. Visitor badge type: "Visitor — Redwood".
Devon: I'll bring a spare power adapter and a notepad.
Pete: Got the envelope and heading up. Bringing a pen too.
Marie (People Ops): FYI parking validation available at the kiosk for 2 hours — tell guest to press "visitor" for validation code.
AJ: Thanks — I'll add a quick note to the calendar invite with parking and lobby instructions.
Devon: Nice — thanks everyone.
Pete: Done — the guest is escorted and everything's in Conf B. All good from my side.
Marie (People Ops): Awesome, thank you team! :tada:
AJ: :thumbsup:
